title: One-Step Virtual Simulation
statement: Let $M$ be an $m$-tape Turing machine over Boolean symbols with state set $S$, and let $c$ be a configuration on a Boolean input word $y$. If $b$ satisfies the boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position, then for every Boolean input word $x$, every virtual input-head position $p$ among the $|x|+2$ positions, and every Boolean list $\mathrm{pre}$, there is a Boolean tag $b'$ satisfying the boundary condition for the input-head position after one step of $M$, such that one step of the virtual simulation from the configuration built from $c,b,p,\mathrm{pre}$ equals the configuration built from the one-step successor of $c$, tag $b'$, the same $p$, and the same $\mathrm{pre}$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a natural number and $S$ is a type
$M$ is an $m$-tape machine over Boolean symbols with states in $S$
$y$ is a Boolean list and $c$ is a configuration on input $y$
$b$ is a Boolean tag satisfying the boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position
$p$ is a position among the $|x|+2$ virtual input-head positions
